sections.basis: monthly taxable employment income (Group A: remuneration less compulsory social security contributions and non-taxable or exempt components)
sections.note: Lei n.º 14/25 (OGE 2026), article 21(3) and annex I (Tabela do IRT), published in the Diário da República of 30 December 2025 and downloaded from the AGT Portal do Contribuinte legislation library (Orçamento Geral do Estado: Lei que Aprova o OGE 2026); in force from 1 January 2026. Each band's tax is the fixed amount (parcela fixa) plus the rate on the excess over the band's lower limit. The fixed amounts are printed as in the annex; they are not the cumulative tax of the bands below (12,500 at Kz 150,000, 31,250 at Kz 200,000), so tax jumps at each limit. The annex does not say "monthly"; the AGT page on IRT says Group A tax is assessed monthly by the employer by applying the IRT table.

Each band's tax is the fixed amount (parcela fixa) plus the rate on the excess over the band's lower limit. The fixed amounts are printed as in the annex; they are not the cumulative tax of the bands below (12,500 at Kz 150,000, 31,250 at Kz 200,000), so tax jumps at each limit. The annex does not say "monthly"; the AGT page on IRT says Group A tax is assessed monthly by the employer by applying the IRT table.
